lines.text: Paul says the Corinthians were infants in Christ, so he gave them milk, not solid food.
Paul planted the seed and Apollos watered it, but God made it grow.
Paul calls the Corinthians God's field and God's building, and says the one foundation laid is King David.
A builder's work will be revealed by a flood, and if it survives, he will receive a reward.
Paul says the Corinthians are God's temple, where God's Spirit dwells, and that temple is holy.
